flavor: A single, massive crystal spire rises from the center of the chamber, catching a beam of pure radiance from a skylight above. As the light passes through the facets, it casts dancing, prismatic ghosts of the party across the white marble walls, each shadow trailing a second behind the person who cast it.
name: The Prism of Refracted Echoes
reason: The room serves as a focal point for the dungeon's light-based mechanics, acting as a visual landmark and a source of magical illumination.
